spec: 11 §5.1 (FE1, FE2), 11 §5.2 (FC1–FC4 and the test-vector table), 10 §3.3 R8, 11 §4 (ts-compat fee)
notes: Formulas (exact decimal, then one HalfAwayFromZero rounding to dp, FC3): PriceWeighted{rate, exp, dp}: fee = C x p x rate x (p(1-p))^exp; Symmetric{rate, exp, dp}: fee = C x rate x (p(1-p))^exp. C = fill quantity, p = fill price. Taker only; maker fee 0 (FC2).
Realistic dp = 5 (minimum fee 0.00001; exact < 0.000005 -> 0). ts-compat dp = 4 and result < 0.0001 -> 0 (src/trading/fees.ts:18-24); ts-compat fee is Symmetric(0.07, 1, 4) on every date (11 §4).
The `wip_wrong` column reproduces the WIP bug of 11 K4/FE2 (Symmetric family with era-1 parameters, 2x too high at p = 0.5); it is listed so a test can assert the engine does NOT produce it.
All 7 rows were recomputed with an independent exact-decimal implementation and match the spec table.
FC3 allows truncating intermediates below 1e-12 USDC; that never changes a HalfAwayFromZero result at 4 or 5 dp (truncation cannot move a value across or onto a half).

ts_compat.text: n/a (11 §4 constant; outputs carry feeCurve null)

wip_wrong.text: WIP bug (11 FE2): MUST NOT be produced

vectors.note: FE1: 100 shares at $0.50 cost $1.75 (P). FE2: era-1 fraction of notional 0.25 x 0.0625 = 1.5625% of 50 = 0.78125.
era3 exact = 0.003465: an exact 5-dp half, HalfAwayFromZero -> 0.00347 (half-up equals half-away for fees >= 0, R8). ts-compat: 0.003465 -> 0.0035.
Symmetric is symmetric in p; PriceWeighted is not (era1 differs from the p = 0.01 row).
era3 exact = 0.00003465 -> 0.00003 (above the 0.00001 minimum); ts-compat 4 dp -> 0.0000 -> below 0.0001 -> 0.

rules.statement: The fee is computed once per fill record by ExchangeRules and stored on the Fill; portfolio, stats and traces only sum fill.fee; nothing recomputes it from a rate.
Only TAKER fills pay; MAKER fills carry fee 0; fee >= 0; charged in USDC (added to a BUY spend, deducted from SELL proceeds).
